title: GameMog Story Kit: story pack v2
description: A story for Mog City's engine (base.engine mogcity-1: mc.gamemog.com plays it with its own HUD, calls, cutscenes, fights and chases), as data only. Closed word lists, bounded numbers (clamped by the gate, not refused) and bounded texts (refused when too long). Places are names from the city; people are Character Forge sheets; rides are vehicle sheets or the engine's stock cars; voices are Kokoro blends. gate.ts holds the rules beyond this schema.

parent.description: a Mog: the pack it remixes (its base is copied and locked)

base.description: what the story runs on; on a Mog, equal to the parent's (locked)

blackout.description: the power is out there (midtown: 34th to 59th St; downtown: below 34th St; manhattan: all of it, the boroughs over the rivers lit): dark windows, street lights and billboards, dead signals, emergency cars, stranded cars, generator-lit islands. Left out, the power is on

place.description: where the hero stands while it plays (on foot, by their car); the establishing shots look at the city around it

time.description: the time of day it plays at (Mission 1's when left out)

stage.description: who else is on the street for it, and where: every person a shot looks at or a card names, but the hero

where.description: the place card (Mog City's 'Murray Hill' / 'E 37th St · Midtown · 5:45 PM'): the name of where we are, and under it the street, the part of town and the time

role.description: one line under the name: who they are to this story ("the fall guy", "the fixer running the auction")

is.description: hero: the player (the pack's hero); antagonist: who is in their way; ally: one of up to 3 others who matter

card.description: a name card: the frame freezes on this person (the shot looks at them: look { rel: <who> }, or 'player' for the hero) and their name comes up with the role in their colour

title.description: the world's title in its own lockup over this shot (exactly one shot; the last is the usual place)

opening.description: the world's opening, played once before Mission 1 (hold Space to skip): an establishing shot of the city with the place card first, a name card for the hero, the antagonist and up to 3 others, the premise in 2 to 4 spoken lines, the title; 30 to 75 s in all

ride.description: the free-drive ride (a vehicle id); the first vehicle when left out

kind.description: count: a plain number that only adds up (supporters), money without the dollars or the choices

places.description: the pack's own names for city places: { key: { "@": cityKey, name } }. Never a coordinate.

voiceOnly.description: heard, never seen (a dispatcher on the phone): no sheet, no body

model.description: a shipped person from the cast registry (public/storykit/cast/registry.json), as they are: their own body, clips, face and recorded lines. No sheet. anchor and voice default to the registry's

name.description: a model person's name (a sheet carries its own): a rename keeps the body

voice.description: A Kokoro-82M voice (storykit/voices/voice-design.js): one stock voice, or a blend of up to 3, then speed and pitch. An invented voice, never a recording or an imitation of a person.

id.description: the voice's id; the cast sheet's voice.id names the same

blend.description: up to 3 voices and their weights (normalised); the heaviest English stock voice is the base, other languages at most 0.35

description.description: the voice in words: age, warmth, pace, accent. Never "sounds like" anyone

species.description: the rigged animals the engine has

model.description: a shipped pet from the cast registry (mogcity/moon: Moon, a small white fluffy dog); without one a dog is built the same way in its coat and size

follows.description: stays with its owner, the hero, as the player plays: trots after them on foot, rides in the car beside them, sits when they stop

stock.description: one of the stock cars as it is (trailhand and vandal: their sheets in storykit/vehicles; roadster: Mog City's own)

voices.description: the voice manifest: line id -> its clip (relative to the pack) or pending. Lines left out are pending; subtitles play until a clip is ready.

oneOf.description: 'player', a place, or the city's named camera point

rel.description: 'player' (his position, in his frame) or a cast id with a body on the street (their head, in their frame)

beingRef.description: a cast id (with a body) or a pet id

speech.description: a spoken line (voiced; a subtitle until its clip is ready)
